description: Entry validation cases shared by apps/backend/convex/entryRules.ts and Android ContentFiles.validateEntry. Entries use the Android pack JSON shape (rank absent = unranked). rule: null means valid; otherwise the single rule the entry breaks (id, fields, answer, examples, metadata, sourceUrl, topic, gender). examples holds 1 to 5 distinct sentences, each with one {answer}. gender absent means the gender the word's article states (content written before gender existed).
